name: Runtipi Self-Hosted App Platform
free_limit: Free GPL-3.0 Docker-based home-server app orchestrator with a web dashboard and one-click app installation; no vendor-hosted compute or usage quota is included.
watch_out: Runs on your own Linux server with Docker; server, electricity, storage, networking, domains and third-party apps may cost money. GPL-3.0 obligations apply when distributing modified software; volunteer-maintained without guaranteed support.
